hero.heading: Deluxe King Room
hero.tagline: Refined comfort with a signature Caribbean touch

overview.body1: The Deluxe King Room is a beautifully appointed retreat that blends premium comfort with the warmth of Caribbean craftsmanship. A plush king bed, refined finishes, and an en-suite bathroom create a space that is both elegant and deeply restful.
overview.body2: Ideal for couples or solo travellers, the Deluxe King Room offers everything you need for a comfortable, stylish stay — with the full concierge service of Stonetrail Villas at your disposal.
